title: Optimal Treatment Assignment Rules on Networked Populations
abstract: arXiv:2610.32735v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: I analyze decision problems where a planner must choose, based on data from an experiment in a pilot population, how to simultaneously distribute a limited number of treatments that generate network spillovers across individuals in a target population. A global treatment rule maps the target population's observed covariates and network features into a jointly feasible allocation. Under local-response, stability, support, and policy-relevant overlap conditions, I identify the resulting welfare using a transported inverse propensity weighted criterion and construct an empirical welfare maximizer. I derive a finite-sample regret bound under restrictions on the complexity of network spillovers and the complexity of the global rule class, measured by its Natarajan dimension. translated_title: 网络化人群中的最优处理分配规则
translated_abstract: 我分析了这样一类决策问题：规划者必须基于在试点人群实验中获得的数据，决定如何同时向目标人群中的个体分配数量有限且会产生网络溢出效应的处理。全局处理规则将目标人群可观测的协变量和网络特征映射为一个联合可行的分配方案。在局部响应、稳定性、支撑集以及与政策相关的重叠条件下，我使用一种传输的逆倾向加权准则识别出由此产生的福利，并构建了经验福利最大化器。在网络溢出效应的复杂度以及全局规则类复杂度（以其 Natarajan 维数衡量）的限制下，我推导出了有限样本遗憾界。该上界利用了节点层面的独立变化以及不施加最大度有界约束的二元网络形成机制。一个极小极大下界建立了相应的……
tldr: 本文研究了在网络溢出效应存在时，如何基于试点实验数据向目标人群最优分配有限处理资源的问题，提出了全局处理规则框架，通过传输逆倾向加权准则识别福利并构建经验福利最大化器，同时给出了以 Natarajan 维数刻画的有限样本遗憾上界及匹配的极小极大下界。
en_tdlr: This paper develops global treatment assignment rules for optimally allocating limited treatments with network spillovers based on pilot experimental data, identifying welfare via a transported inverse propensity weighted criterion, constructing an empirical welfare maximizer, and establishing finite-sample regret bounds that match a minimax lower bound.
